biotools.summary: jaxQTL is a flexible and efficient sc-eQTL mapping framework using count-based models, designed to analyze sparse counts in scRNA-seq data and large datasets. It has been shown to identify more eGenes compared with existing approaches, improving our ability to identify distal eQTLs.
